title: The Evidence Equator: An Autonomous Sovereignty Engine for African Health Research
primary_estimand: Condition Colonialism Index (CCI) and Sovereignty Ledger for 57 health dimensions
certainty: High (Synthesized from 1.3M AACT trials joined with WHO/World Bank data)
data: AACT (2026-04-12), WHO GHED, World Bank Silver
body: How can African health leaders systematically quantify and reclaim research sovereignty in a data-fragmented global landscape? We developed 'The Evidence Equator,' an autonomous engine joining 1.3 million clinical trials with WHO health expenditure and disease burden datasets. The system calculates a Condition Colonialism Index (CCI) and a 'Sovereignty Ledger' to detect extractive research patterns across fifty-seven dimensions. Critical findings reveal extreme mismatches in sickle cell and heart failure, where African burden carries massive 'Evidence Debt' from high-income cohorts. We implemented a forensic 'TruthCert' auditor and a phenotypic distance simulator to issue prescriptive mandates for local bridging trials. Funding archetype analysis shows that commercial research often targets African sites without sufficient technology transfer, yielding low 'Self-Reliance Scores.' This platform transforms descriptive audits into a strategic asset for ministries to negotiate mandatory tech-transfer as a prerequisite for commercial entry. The analysis is limited by registry metadata completeness and requires live site-level verification to finalize regulatory trust certificates.
